title: Geometric planted matchings in high dimensions: The power of multiple views
summary: We study the problem of recovering the correspondence between a collection of $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^d$ and a noisy, permuted version of those points. In the high-dimensional regime $d=ω(\log n)$, under a Gaussian model with noise variance $σ^2=d/(b\log n)$, prior work identifies $b=2$ as the threshold for almost exact recovery. We prove that this threshold is all-or-nothing: for every fixed $b K/(K-1)$.
